screening_answers.question: Why do you want to work at Alternative Path as a Full Stack Developer?
screening_answers.answer: The role asks for the way I already work: full-stack delivery on Node.js, React, Python and PostgreSQL, with LLM tools such as Claude Code used every day for scaffolding, debugging and test generation. I also like that a developer here owns an application end to end, from schema to UI to post-launch support, and works on varied problems for different teams. I have spent 3 years as a Full Stack Developer at a US-based medical-device company and want to apply that in a consulting setting.

screening_answers.question: Describe your experience using AI/LLM developer tools in your daily workflow.
screening_answers.answer: I use Claude Code every day for scaffolding, debugging, test generation and documentation, and I review every diff before it is merged. I hold Anthropic's Claude Code in Action and Claude Code 101 certificates and the Claude Certified Developer – Foundations credential. I have also built AI features: site-to-agent (a website turned into a chat agent with hybrid BM25 + vector retrieval, cited answers and an eval harness) and internal AI agents at the US-based medical-device company.

screening_answers.question: Tell us about a full-stack project you are proud of.
screening_answers.answer: Orbital Surplus (orbital-surplus.vercel.app), a full-stack store on Node 20 and Postgres (Neon) with Stripe in test mode. It is a fictional demo brand, not a client project. Stock holds run in one transaction (UPDATE … WHERE stock >= qty) so only one shopper wins the last unit. Payment confirmation is idempotent, whether it arrives via the return page or a signed webhook. It has customer accounts, discount codes, an admin with partial refunds and 9 end-to-end API tests.

screening_answers.question: Rate your experience with AWS (EC2, S3, Lambda, RDS) and MySQL.
screening_answers.answer: I have not used AWS or MySQL in production, and I would rather say so plainly. My hosting so far has been Vercel and Neon (managed Postgres), with Docker and GitHub Actions for CI. Those map directly to Lambda, RDS, S3 and CI deploys. On PostgreSQL I am strong: schema design, indexing, partial unique indexes, transactions, migrations and row-level security. MySQL syntax differences are small and I can pick them up quickly. [CONFIRM: only mention a small AWS deployment if you have actually done one before submitting.]

screening_answers.question: Are you comfortable working directly with clients and managing multiple engagements?
screening_answers.answer: At the US-based medical-device company I built internal applications and a CRM for the teams that used them, and as CTO of NeuroNetworks AI Ed I write specs and sizing for stakeholders. I have not worked in a client-services firm, so managing several client engagements at once would be new to me. I am comfortable asking questions, writing things down and keeping people updated.

screening_answers.question: What is your expected salary?
screening_answers.answer: I am targeting INR 30,000 per month or more, and I am flexible on structure. I would like to understand the band for this role. [CONFIRM: confirm you are happy to state this figure on the form.]

screening_answers.question: What is your current CTC?
screening_answers.answer: [CONFIRM: current/last drawn CTC at the US-based medical-device company, which Hussain has not stated in his files.]

screening_answers.question: What is your notice period / when can you join?
screening_answers.answer: Immediate. My previous role ended in September 2026.

screening_answers.question: Work mode, location and working hours?
screening_answers.answer: I am based in Pune, India (IST, UTC+05:30) and am comfortable working fully remotely. I am happy to overlap with client time zones, including US mornings.
